overview: A multi-campus NPTEL portal for RGUKT supporting four campuses (Nuzvid, Srikakulam, RK Valley, Ongole) with strict campus isolation, role-based dashboards for Students, HODs, and Deans, academic year/semester selection, file-driven data management, error validation, exam shuffle, and versioned uploads.
features: Academic year/semester selection with full database isolation per selection
Campus-isolated role-based dashboards (Student, HOD, Dean) for 4 campuses
File-driven enrollment and exam registration with CSV/Excel parsing (100k+ rows)
Error validation with course ID format checks, email validation, cross-match detection
Exam shuffle upload and display with Roll No and Seating Position
File versioning with restore from previous uploads
HOD bulk edit mode with credit system
Error download as Excel for HOD and Dean
Double-prefix and personal email login support
Separate enrollment and exam registration statistics with branch-wise breakdowns
